title: Presets are separate from the layout
description: Why presets have their own store and file.
body: Presets live in presets.json, not layout.json, because layout.json is what is on screen right now and is rewritten on every drag. Presets are a small, deliberate, rarely-changing library of user data that outlives every layout they were captured from. Folding them in would mean one corrupt write costing both, and putting a file rewritten hundreds of times a session in charge of something expected to last a year.
